caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate candlestick rendered in shades of green, giving the appearance of a glass or crystal material. The candlestick features a hexagonal base with beveled edges and a series of tiered sections that taper upward, incorporating angular and rounded designs. The mid-section includes both curved and angular features, transitioning to a narrower top that flares slightly outward at the opening. The background is a plain off-white or cream color, with a simple thin rectangular border outlining the drawing. The bottom left corner bears the inscription "JOHN DANA." There are no additional objects or extraneous details within the composition.
